messages:
marc: Recording + quick note: thanks everyone for the thoughtful questions in the all‑hands. I uploaded the short summary and the recording here: https://redwood.internal/all-hands/1817654321 :link: 
sophia: TL;DR of the announcement — we are shifting headcount to prioritize Platform Reliability and Dedicated capacity work. This means some teams will see reduced hiring budget, others will get incremental slots. We know you want specifics; I’ll answer what I can here. :wave:
alexa: Context from leadership: market conditions + need to prioritize predictable infra and enterprise readiness (Dedicated & Private). This is a strategic reallocation, not a product pause. We still invest in model serving & cost/perf features.

devon: Can you share numbers? How many roles are moving or being decommitted vs newly approved?
sophia: Short numbers: company ~150 people today. Net budget reduction of ~7% for recruiting for Q2 (so ~10 FTE equivalent held back). Rough split: ~6 roles reallocated into Platform Reliability / Dedicated, ~4 roles paused across non-critical product initiatives. These are org-level plans, not names.
cheng: Are we doing layoffs or just hiring freezes/pauses? Need clarity for people leads.
sophia: No broad layoffs planned as part of this reorg. Primary action is an immediate hiring pause on open requisitions that are not flagged as critical. We will run a 2‑week review window where managers can petition to keep reqs open (see process below).
paul: From Recruiting: effective immediately we mark open reqs as `paused` unless they are approved as `critical-hire` by an exec. If you're a manager and think a req is critical, file a ticket to #recruiting-approvals with justification + metrics (impact, time-to-ship risk, revenue/security impact). We will triage within 48 hours. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
hr-bot: Internal doc: https://redwood.internal/hr/headcount-q2 — includes petition form, severance FAQ, and manager talking points.
marc: Manager talking points (please use in 1:1s):
```
Hey — leadership is re-prioritizing hiring to strengthen Platform Reliability and Dedicated. No mass layoffs; some external hiring will be paused for 2 weeks while we review. If your role is impacted we will discuss options and timelines privately. We’ll share updates as decisions are finalized.
```
devon: For org mapping, how will Platform Reliability be structured? Is it a new reporting chain?
sophia: It will be a new horizontal team under Eng Infra with a dotted reporting model to Product for SLA/roadmap alignment. High-level sketch: 
```
eng
├─ eng-platform
├─ eng-runtime
├─ eng-ml
└─ eng-infra
   └─ platform-reliability (new)
```
We’ll publish a fuller org chart by EOW.
cheng: What about transfers/internal mobility? If my engineer wants to move to Platform Reliability, is that allowed?
paul: Yes — internal transfers are encouraged. We will fast-track internal candidates for openings in priority areas. Internal apps use the same req but are flagged `internal-fasttrack`. Hiring managers: expect a 1‑week turnaround for interviews for internal applicants.
marc: Any changes to interview loops or levels?
sophia: Not to leveling; we may tighten the hiring bar temporarily to approve only roles with clear impact. Interview panels will include an infra/product stakeholder for Dedicated-related hires.
alexa: Timeline & next steps: 1) Immediate pause and 2‑week petition window. 2) Final decisions & updated org chart by end of week. 3) 1:1s with affected managers next week. We’ll follow up with a company FAQ doc and suggested manager scripts.
devon: Will contractors be affected?
sophia: Contractors will be reviewed case-by-case. Expect some contract renewals to be deferred; business-critical contractors can be extended with approval.
cheng: Compensation / severance questions — where do we point folks?
hr-bot: Severance & benefits FAQ: https://redwood.internal/hr/severance-q2 (answers to common questions + legal contacts).
marc: One more — are we freezing external hiring for specialized ML research roles? Those are high-leverage for our long-term model roadmap.
alexa: Research roles are considered on a case-by-case basis. We are prioritizing roles directly tied to inference performance and cost improvements (e.g., runtime optimizations, quantization work). Please route those through the `recruiting-approvals` path and tag `inference-impact`.
paul: I'll follow up with a list of all paused requisitions in Greenhouse and owners by EOD.
sophia: Thanks everyone. If you have sensitive concerns about people, please DM People Ops for confidential support. We know this is stressful — we’re aiming for transparency and speed. :heart:
marc: OK closing the thread — will post the updated org chart + paused-req list once Paul sends it. Thanks for the questions and clear asks.
